summary: America's Car-Mart filed an 8-K disclosing a First Amendment and Limited Waiver to its Credit Agreement with Silver Point Finance. The amendment waives specified defaults including minimum liquidity and collateral coverage covenant failures, and delayed audit delivery, from June 19, 2026 through September 7, 2026 (extendable to November 6, 2026). The company must meet milestone targets to keep the waiver alive; any other default or missed milestone triggers immediate termination. This is a pre-restructuring forbearance; watch for covenant compliance trajectory and potential debt restructuring or distressed exchange.
